notes.title: Artemis Book Two - Now Available
notes.content: [h2][b]Book Two is now available to purchase![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Book Two currently features Chapters 5 and 6[/p][p][/p][p]Chapter 7 is currently in development and will be updated when completed. 8 will follow after when development is complete for that chapter as well.[/p][p][/p][p]Chapters 5 & 6 features:[/p][p]10,199 story renders[/p][p]276 VFX and animations[/p][p]135 New tracks[/p][p]11 New SD Cards[/p][p]7 New wallpapers for the phones.[/p][p][/p][p]See the main page for the bundle price[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1775530/Artemis_Book_One/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
